shot.image_note: adult woman, dark hair slicked back, metallic geometric top, black photo studio, hard key light
shot.beat: She slowly lifts the metallic top off over her head, tosses it aside and turns her bare upper body toward the key light, holding eye contact. She steps closer to the camera, tilts her head back and runs both hands up through her slicked-back hair, then smiles. Use two [Shot N] segments with a hard cut to a closer angle halfway.
